subject: SIG initiation & SOC2/GDPR clarification — Mediq Health
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@mediqhealth.com>, Tom D'Souza <tom.dsouza@mediqhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Mar 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG initiation & SOC2/GDPR clarification — Mediq Health

Thanks again for the time this morning — great conversation. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can move the security intake forward: 

What we heard from your side:
- Mediq plans to verify HIPAA applicability for patient-identifiable workflows (you indicated yes for covered workflows).
- You have EU customers; data residency / cross-border handling is a consideration.
- SOC 2 status: you asked about our current report and whether Redwood can provide evidence now.
- You prefer a SIG/CAIQ workflow vs a custom form, but are open to a short custom supplement for HIPAA items.

Immediate asks from Mediq we can act on:
1) Confirm which environments (prod, staging) are in scope for the questionnaire.
2) Preferred retention window for logs and backups.
3) Any special encryption/PKI requirements beyond standard TLS and at-rest encryption.

Attachments I’m including to accelerate the review: Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf (brief summary of controls & SOC2 posture) and a SIG prefill template (Redwood_SIG_prefill.xlsx) — the prefill highlights where we can answer on your behalf to reduce reviewer effort.

Next steps I propose:
- Please confirm scope (prod vs prod+staging) and retention target by EOD Mon so we can prefill the SIG appropriately.
- If you want us to lead the SIG prefill we’ll have Karthik (cc’d, our security intake lead) own the responses.
- Schedule a 30-min tech sync with your security/infra team and Karthik next week to walk the completed prefill.

If procurement needs to be looped in now, please add procurement@mediqhealth.com to replies.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf (1.2 MB), Redwood_SIG_prefill.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@mediqhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom D'Souza <tom.dsouza@mediqhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@mediqhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Mar 2028 13:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & SOC2/GDPR clarification — Mediq Health

Thanks Vanessa — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirming HIPAA applies to the flows discussed (PD/PHI). We will need a BAA; please confirm Redwood's standard BAA term sheet or a draft we can review.
- SOC 2: we understand many vendors will be in process. Can you confirm whether Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II currently, and if not, whether you can provide an SOC 2 in-progress letter / timeline? We need an expected date.
- Data residency: Mediq is US-headquartered but some data will be processed for EU customers. Please indicate whether Redwood supports regional isolation (EU region) or whether data might be routed through US zones.
- For the SIG vs CAIQ: we usually prefer the SIG (Excel) but will accept a CAIQ JSON if easier. Please pick one and prefill to save time.

I’ve attached a short scope document that shows the systems likely in scope for this review (Mediq_Scope_Details.pdf). We’d like to get the prefilled SIG back to our security reviewers by next Wednesday.

Can you also answer whether Redwood signs BAAs and whether you have any special encryption at-rest key management requirements (do you use customer-managed keys or Redwood-managed keys)?

—Claire
Head of Security Operations
Mediq Health

Attachment stubs: Mediq_Scope_Details.pdf (240 KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@mediqhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@mediqhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Mar 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & SOC2/GDPR clarification — Mediq Health

Claire — thanks, great questions. I’m looping Karthik in as the security intake owner (he’ll run the prefill and be the day-to-day for evidence follow-ups). Short answers below and some follow-ups where we need your input: 

Short answers: 
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type I (2026) and is undergoing Type II audit with an expected reporting window in July 2028. We can provide a letter from our compliance team summarizing the audit timeline and the controls mapped today (attach: Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf).
- BAA: yes, Redwood signs BAAs. I’ve added procurement on thread — we can circulate a draft BAA (DocuSign link included) after you confirm scope.
- Data residency: Redwood supports regional deployments; we can isolate EU customer data in EU-hosted clusters. For the hosted API, region is configurable per workload.
- Encryption/KMS: default is Redwood-managed keys for hosted customers; we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for Dedicated and Private deployments.

Questions for Mediq to confirm before we prefill: 
1) Scope: please confirm "production only" vs "prod + staging" for the initial review.
2) Retention: target log retention window (30/90/365 days) and any long-term backup retention expectations.
3) Evidence timeline: what is your target date to complete the SIG prefill return? You mentioned next Wednesday — is that Mar 22?

I am attaching our prefill file (Redwood_SIG_prefill.xlsx) with the fields Karthik plans to answer. If you prefer CAIQ JSON instead we can export the prefill.

Proposed next steps: Karthik to take the prefill action; proposed 30-min tech sync slots: Tue 21 Mar 09:00–09:30 PT or Wed 22 Mar 15:00–15:30 PT. Let me know which works.

Thanks — looping Karthik to confirm availability and to share the prefill once he reviews.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: Redwood_SIG_prefill.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF). Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/mediq-health, https://app.docusign.com/containers/abc123

From: Tom D'Souza <tom.dsouza@mediqhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@mediqhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@mediqhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Mar 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & SOC2/GDPR clarification — Mediq Health

Thanks Vanessa and Claire. A few updates from procurement/security scheduling: 
- Scope: we’ll scope production systems for now, plus logs (1 year retention) — staging out of scope for this pass.
- Target for prefilled SIG: Tue 22 Mar COB would be ideal for our reviewers (gives us 2 business days).
- BAA: procurement asked for a draft BAA to review. Can you send the draft to procurement@mediqhealth.com?
- SOC2 letter: please share the SOC2 in-progress letter / timeline as an interim artifact — that will help our legal/compliance triage.

I’m attaching the completed SIG prefill we started (Mediq_SIG_prefill_completed.xlsx) — Karthik, please review and flag anything you cannot answer from the prefill; we can fill the rest during the tech sync.

We can do a 30-min tech sync Tue 22 Mar 09:00 PT — does that work for Karthik?

Thanks,
Tom D'Souza
Sr. Manager, Vendor Risk & Procurement
Mediq Health

Attachment stubs: Mediq_SIG_prefill_completed.xlsx (spreadsheet)
